youtube_title: Averaging Down a Falling Stock? Read This First 🔪 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Buying more every time your stock falls? Here's the hidden math.

A stock down 50% needs +100% to recover. Down 90%? It needs +900%. Real case: Yes Bank was ₹382 in Aug 2018 and touched ₹5.55 on 6 Mar 2020, about 98% down. Every 'average' on the way made the loss bigger. A falling price is not a discount; sometimes the business itself is breaking.

Rule: average only if the business is still good, and cap how much goes into one stock.
Moral: Average a good business, not a falling price.

Sources: Business Today (6 Mar 2020); Kuvera.
Education only, not investment advice. Not a view on any stock.
